name: web-dark-basic-dialog-with-header-body-and-two-footer-buttons
title: Dark modal 'Hello there!' with a close icon, hairline sections and Close and Okay buttons on black
whatItIs: A black screen with a dark grey rounded dialog: a header with a bold title, a grey subline and an x, a hairline, a body sentence, a hairline and a footer with a dark Close button and a light Okay button.
whatItMeans: Quiet and orderly; hairlines and tonal buttons keep a dialog light on dark.
techniques: Divide header, body and footer with hairlines.
Use a light primary against dark secondary.

vocabulary.definition: A modal window with a message and actions.
Buttons aligned at the bottom right.
A thin line separating dialog parts.
A dark and a light button side by side.
